hardware: NVIDIA GB10 (SM121), 128 GB unified memory; CUDA 13.0
software: Torch 2.13.0+cu130, SGLang 0.5.21, Transformers 5.12.1, Triton 3.7.1, CuTe DSL 4.8.0
command: fissile quantize --model MODEL --calibration calibration.jsonl --packs-dir packs --output manifest.json

calibration.selection: Every 304th question of the full evaluation suite

preparation.includes: model load, calibration forwards, pack preparation and serialization

evaluation.protocol: One engine; 48-request warm-up, then one timed pass over every question (CheckedSession.score).
evaluation.decision: Four-decimal candidate probabilities, lexical tie break (scripts/benchmark_sglang.py decode_choice)

published-packs.note: Packs used for the other gb10-mixed-v2 results; 96 separate calibration requests

bitwise_reproduction.note: Preparation from the input moments of the published packs reproduces them byte for byte
